record.question: Cotton Gin was invented by
record.explanation: Answer C: Eli Whitney. Eli Whitney patented the cotton gin in 1794; among these choices he is the inventor associated with it. Reference: https://www.si.edu/spotlight/american-history/cotton-gin. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
